title: Equity Accounting Worksheet — Class H Preferred Stock Redemption Allowance Base after Activity in the Quarter
content:
Where a Member Equities & Patronage Class H Preferred Stock holding's latest entries show activity inside the current quarter, the redemption allowance base is measured on the shares after that activity. The current quarter runs from 1 July 2026 to 30 September 2026.

## Rule

| Latest entries of the holding | Redemption allowance base |
|---|---|
| The latest reinvested dividend is dated inside the quarter and the latest retirement is not | The start-of-quarter shares plus that reinvested dividend |
| The latest retirement is dated inside the quarter | The start-of-quarter shares less that retirement |
| Otherwise | The start-of-quarter shares |

When the latest retirement is dated inside the quarter, the base is the start-of-quarter shares less that retirement whether or not the latest reinvested dividend is also dated inside it.

## Terms used

- **Start-of-quarter shares**: the shares the holding carried at the start of the current quarter — its present shares (purchases plus reinvested dividends less retirements) less its latest reinvested dividend and its latest purchase when either is dated inside the quarter, plus its latest retirement when that is dated inside the quarter.
- **Latest** reinvested dividend or retirement: the entry of that kind with the latest effective date on the holding; a retirement is any entry recorded as a retirement, whatever its reason.
- **Inside the quarter**: dated on or after 1 July 2026 and on or before 30 September 2026.

## Worked lines (hypothetical holdings)

| Holding | Start-of-quarter shares | Base |
|---|---|---|
| Present shares 80,000.00; latest reinvested dividend 850.00 dated 15 July 2026; latest retirement dated in 2025 | 79,150.00 | 79,150.00 plus 850.00 gives 80,000.00 |
| Present shares 78,000.00; latest reinvested dividend 850.00 dated 15 July 2026; latest retirement 2,000.00 dated 20 July 2026 | 78,000.00 less 850.00 plus 2,000.00 gives 79,150.00 | 79,150.00 less 2,000.00 gives 77,150.00 |
| Present shares 64,000.00; latest dividend, purchase and retirement all dated before 1 July 2026 | 64,000.00 | 64,000.00 |
